description: Convenience tool — returns the most-recent issue summary (same shape as one element of ic_signal_list_issues.issues[]). No auth required. Args: { include_stories?: boolean (default false — when true the issue's story list is inlined as stories[] with id/title/dek, saving a follow-up ic_signal_get_issue round trip) }.
name: ic_signal_get_latest
title: Get the latest SIGNAL issue summary (public)
